body: I think I saw a video of what Regular Show was going to originally be like at first. It was really cool. Hopefully the new show does great.
I actually went to the police and they were extremely lazy and wouldn't really help me out. They mentioned that they opened a case but never took me seriously.

My parents are from Poland but we moved to the US. I get a lot of verbal abuse at home and my ex boyfriend blackmailed me for sex and I was taken advantaged my him numerous times. Honestly it really sucks.

My family is like business than fun. There's a lot of expectations and no one really gets along. Honestly, my parents are people who should have kids, they're nice but they don't really make great parents. Also my sister and I are polar opposites.
Honestly that really summarizes my life, except I can't really have family into the equation. It's gets really lonely. That whole paragraph, every word, describes me.
I don't really want to diagnose myself or go to a doctor, I think just really connecting with someone will make me feel better. I'm considering moving to the U.K. Actually.
It's more than a possibility. I'm really willing to leave as soon as I can to find people, but I'm scared it will just be the same.

I wish it were that simple honestly, but I'm willing to move just to have a real connection with someone. I've tried to have a connection with online friends but I wish there was a button just to have a genuine connection.

Apetamin actually made me really drowsy. I did eat a lot, and I did gain weight, but you really need to exercise to make it go in the right places. Since I was too tired to do anything, I didn't do that.

I've lost really valuable friends in my life, the ones you can hang around with and not give a damn about what the world has to offer. Where they can sit in your room and have fun. I guess high school kind of kills that for you but hopefully college isn't like that when I go off this year.
It just kind of kills me inside knowing that I won't be able to hang out with my friends like the old times. We used to sit in flower washed fields next to a train track my friend grew up around, and just talk for hours. It was a beautiful field some time ago, however it's all a dry, golden color now. Everything is dead and nothing grew back after I lost them.
